originalProposals.reason: Hormone potency (tiny amount, whole-body effect) is sound, but no current endocrine/hormone core facet exists. G4-L-1 is muscular/skeletal/digestive/circulatory/respiratory only and is not admitted. Salt/body hits are mixture/water-need traps (G6-M-7, G7-M-11, G10-M-2, G4-E-2). TL/BIS keep hormone; asin/ulam OK. Potential new G8 endocrine-system facet.

Endothermic/ectothermic as warm-/cold-blooded labels is standard school terminology, but G5-L-4 table-classification of named groups is not admitted and the card does not use a table. G10-M-9 endothermic is chemical exo/endothermic (homonym trap). Heat/warm hits (G5-F-3, G7-E-9, G4-E-9) are friction/sun/atmosphere. TL/BIS keep endothermic/ectothermic. Potential G5-L-4/G5-L-9 after thermoregulation-classification wording.

Metabolic heat loss during life processes is sound but is intra-organism bioenergetics, not G7-L-10 food-pyramid transfer between trophic levels (less-energy is admitted via lost/heat without pyramid/trophic frame). G4-F-9:forms names heat but does not identify energy as causing change including light/sound/heat; G4-F-10 community heat sources/uses and G8-F-9 gravity/falling losses are not taught. G4-L-1 digest is incidental. TL/BIS keep energy/init. Potential G7-L-10 after trophic heat-loss wording, or G4-F-9 after energy-causes-change framing.

Conservation of energy (never created or destroyed; changes form) is sound, but G8-F-9 (gravity/falling situations) is not admitted (needs friction|air resistance|heat|thermal). G4-F-9:change is energy causing change including light/sound/heat, not transformation of forms; G8-F-5 KE/PE examples are not admitted. Created/creat is a G4-M-1 invention trap. TL/BIS keep enerhiya/anyo/porma. Potential G8-F-9 after general conservation-of-energy wording.

PH is among the world's largest geothermal producers because of volcanoes (currently ~3rd after US/Indonesia; Ring of Fire: https://gulfnews.com/world/asia/philippines/how-a-126-billion-bet-could-make-the-philippines-asias-ultimate-clean-energy-superpower-1.500662861). G10-E-12 geothermal is renewable mitigation / better use of PH resources, not current production rank. G8-F-10 is hydropower dams; G8-E-5/G10-E-3 are volcano distribution/maps. TL/BIS keep geothermal/bulkan. Potential G10-E-12 after geothermal-as-renewable-mitigation wording.

Sun as the main source of energy we use on Earth is sound, but G3-F-5 is sources of light (not energy-we-use); G4-E-7 Sun characteristics (composition/size/radiated energy) is not admitted; G4-F-9/G4-F-10 light-sound-heat forms/uses are not admitted. G3-L-7 environment is living things' basic needs, not human energy supply. Source/report hits are secondary-source activity traps. TL araw / BIS adlaw OK. Potential G4-E-7 or G4-F-10 after sun-as-energy-source facet.

Joule as SI unit of energy and work, named for James Joule, is correct, but G8-F-7 is power as the rate of doing work (watt|joule units facet does not teach power/rate). G8-F-6 force-displacement is not admitted; G8-F-8 is mechanical energy KE+PE; G7-M-7 investigation units are meter/gram/second/liter. G4-M-1 needs invent|develop|creat (a unit is not an invention). TL/BIS keep joule/SI unit. Potential G8-F-7 after energy/work-unit facet separate from power.

Mung bean epigeal vs corn hypogeal germination is sound, but G6-L-2 is ways plants reproduce (pollination/seed production/propagation), not cotyledon position. G8-L-3 leaves is transport; G3-L-7/G6-L-7 soil are dependence/abiotic labels; G3-E-7 rise/set is sky motion; G8-F-5 rise is KE-to-PE. TL mungo / BIS mongo OK. Potential G6-L-2 or G5-L-6 after germination/seedling facet.

Epiphyte roots clinging to bark/cracks and not reaching the ground is placement only, not the purpose of aerial roots (G5-L-7 not admitted; needs rhizome|tuber|thorn|bulb|aerial). G8-L-3 roots is transport; G3-L-8 tree is protect-habitats, not conservation teaching; G3-F-4 reach is sound transfer. TL ugat / BIS gamot OK; epiphyte kept. Potential G5-L-7 after aerial-root purpose wording.

Staghorn fern clinging to trees and catching water and rotting leaves is a current G3-L-7:environment example of a living thing depending on other living things and on the environment for needs. G3-L-6:water names a need of all living things rather than this epiphyte strategy and is not claimed. G5-L-4 fern is a classification table (not credited); G5-L-7 aerial-root purpose is not admitted; G4-E-9 is Sun importance (keyword water); G6-L-8 good/harm is not explicit. TL/BIS keep epiphyte; hugis-sungay/porma sa sungay OK. Full EN/TL/BIS and both pools inspected; single identical card ID.

evidence.quote: it clings to trees and catches water and rotting leaves

originalProposals.reason: Two equinoxes per year (March and September) is correct, but G7-E-11 (tilt and daytime length, using models) is not admitted (needs daylight|day length|tilt model). G6-E-8 Sun-Earth-Moon model/seasons/eclipses is not admitted. Sole hit G3-F-7 loud-sound is 'ear' inside 'year'. TL/BIS keep equinox. Potential G7-E-11 after equinox/equal-day-night facet.

Rain/wind/water wearing mountains down is weathering-as-wearing, not G5-E-5 demonstrating how erosion transports Earth materials (carry|carries|transport|move not matched; demonstration facet needs tray|pour|model). G5-E-1:mountain is local landform identification/influence, not erosion process; G3-F-1 wind/water is making objects move; G3-M-1 rain is local everyday events, not mountain-building vs erosion. TL naaagnas / BIS nakaykay OK. Potential G5-E-5 after wearing-down/weathering facet.

Escalator as motor-driven looping chain staircase is a complex machine, not G6-F-1 simple machines (not admitted). G10-F-11 motor vs generator is not a comparison; G5-F-8 complete-loop is an electric circuit, not a mechanical chain loop; G7-M-3 is particle motion. TL/BIS hagdan/hagdanan OK. Potential G6-F-1 after compound-machine/motor example, or G10-F-11 after motor-use example.

Esophageal peristalsis (wave-like squeeze; swallow upside down) is how the gullet works, but G4-L-1:digestive is not admitted (needs digest|break.*food) and G5-L-1/G8-L-1 require pictures/labeled diagrams tracing named digestive parts/processes (not credited). G4-F-6 squeeze is forces changing object shape; G3-F-8 wave is sending messages. TL pumipiga / BIS moduso OK. Potential G4-L-1 or G5-L-1 after esophagus/gullet/peristalsis facet.

Ethanol boiling ~78°C, below water, is correct, but G7-M-5:heating is change of state in terms of particle arrangement and energy, not a boiling-point fact. G5-M-8 is using mg/g/kg/°C in science activities, not stating a substance's boiling point. G6-M-1 diagrams/flowcharts of melting/evaporation/freezing/condensation not admitted. Water hits are traps. TL/BIS keep ethanol/Celsius. Potential G7-M-5 after boiling-point/particle-energy wording, or G5-M-8 after unit-use activity.

Filipino shrews eating insects and living in forests is a current G3-L-7:food-and-shelter example of living things depending on other living things for food and on the environment for habitat. PH has endemic Crocidura shrews in forest that eat insects (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Etruscan_shrew is the comparison species, not claimed as Philippine). G4-L-6 herbivore/carnivore/omnivore grouping is not admitted; G4-L-7 is a labeled food-chain drawing (not credited); G5-L-4 insects is a table; G6-L-4 backbone difference is not taught; G3-L-8 forest is conservation, not taught. TL/BIS keep shrew/insekto/kagubatan. Full EN/TL/BIS and both pools inspected; single identical card ID.

evidence.quote: Filipino shrews are small, eat insects, and live in our forests.

originalProposals.reason: Europa's likely subsurface ocean and possible microbial life is a supported NASA/Galileo inference, but G5-E-11 solar-system structure (sun-center / asteroid-comet / rocky-gas-ice giants) is not admitted. G3-E-6:moon is guided observation of Earth's Moon in the sky; G3-L-6/G4-E-2 water-as-basic-need are Earth organisms; G9-E-8 crust is Earth's interior layers; G10-L-6 microb is biotechnology. TL/BIS keep Europa/ocean/microbial life. Potential G5-E-11 after moons-of-planets/features facet, or G9-E-9 after icy-moon wording.

Volcano danger zones where people may not live is sound safety content, but G6-E-5 (PHIVOLCS alerts; before/during/after) is not admitted (needs plan|prepare|before|evacuat|PHIVOLCS). G6-E-2 local volcano location/risk is not admitted. G3-E-5:danger is weather danger; G4-E-6 is weather-chart safety; G8-E-5/G10-E-3 are volcano distribution/maps. TL/BIS keep danger zones/bulkan. Potential G6-E-5 after danger-zone/no-habitation facet, or G6-E-2 eruption-risk.

Octopus vs vertebrate camera-eye as convergent evolution is a classic comparative-morphology example, but G10-L-5 (fossils/biogeography/comparative morphology; secondary sources) is not admitted. G10-L-3 natural selection is not admitted. G6-L-4 vertebrate is backbone difference, not eyes; G9-E-3/G10-E-2 convergent is plate boundaries. TL/BIS keep convergent evolution/octopus/vertebrate. Potential G10-L-5 after comparative-morphology/convergent-evolution facet.

Evolution has no fixed goal and is not always toward greater complexity (bush metaphor) is sound, but G10-L-3/L-4/L-5 evolution/natural-selection/evidence facets are not admitted. G3-L-3:grow is the growing-bush metaphor trap; G8-M-4 fixed composition is chemistry. TL ebolusyon / BIS ebolusyon OK. Potential G10-L-3 after evolution-has-no-goal facet.

Patintero/tumbang preso/luksong tinik as exercise (run, jump, move) is local PE, not G4-L-1 how muscular/skeletal systems work (not admitted; muscular needs muscle.*(move|contract)|muscular). G3-E-5 activities is weather affecting daily activities; G7-M-3 is particle motion; G10-F-12 Filipin is household electricity. TL/BIS keep game names. Potential G4-L-1 after exercise/muscular-use facet.

Using muscles through exercise makes them stronger is sound, but G4-L-1:muscular is not admitted (needs muscle.*(move|contract)|muscular) and the competency is how the muscular system works (contract to move), not training hypertrophy. Use/help hits are invention/mixture traps. TL kalamnan / BIS kaunoran OK. Potential G4-L-1 after muscle-use/exercise facet.

Steady exercise strengthening lungs/breathing is sound, but G5-L-2:lungs is not admitted (needs lung AND oxygen AND blood/CO2) and requires pictures/diagrams of nose/windpipe/lungs. G4-L-1:respiratory needs lung.*(oxygen|gas)|respirat. Sole hit G3-L-7 food-and-shelter is a spurious eat-in-steady. TL baga / BIS baga OK. Potential G5-L-2 or G4-L-1 after exercise-respiratory facet.

Transit spectroscopy of exoplanet atmospheres (starlight through atmosphere; water/oxygen biosignatures) is sound astronomy, but no current spectroscopy/exoplanet facet admits it. G3-E-6 planets/stars is guided sky observation; G4-F-8 light-at-a-distance is magnets/sun/loud noise; G6-M-5 oxygen is air mixture; G5-E-11 solar-system structure is not admitted. TL/BIS keep exoplanet/spectrum/biosignatures. Potential new G8/G9 astronomy spectroscopy facet.

Iris muscles changing pupil size to control incoming light is sound, but no current eye/senses core facet admits it. G4-L-1 body systems omit nervous/sensory; G4-F-9 light/change is energy causing change; G3-E-9/G3-F-7 are Sun-light safety; G4-E-7 size is the Sun's size. TL balintataw / BIS kalimutaw OK. Potential new G6 senses/eye-parts facet.

Retinal rods (dim) and cones (color/bright) is sound, but no current eye/senses facet admits it. G7-L-3 unicellular/multicellular is a cell-keyword trap (photoreceptors in a multicellular human); G4-F-9/G4-F-10 are energy forms/uses of light; G8-E-4 cone-shape is volcano cones; G3-F-7 bright-light is harmful light. TL/BIS keep rod/cone cells; photoreceptor kept. Potential new G6 senses/eye-parts facet.

Eyebrows steering rainwater from the eyes is a common body-protection fact, but G3-E-9:eye-protection is safety from the Sun's light, not rain. G3-M-1 rain is local everyday science events (cook/shadow/melt), not a body-part function; G4-E-4 rain is a weather descriptor; G3-F-7 bright-light is harmful light. TL kilay / BIS kilay OK. Potential new body-protection/senses facet.

Eyelashes catching dust/dirt before it enters the eye is sound, but G3-E-9:eye-protection and G3-F-7:bright-light are Sun/harmful-light safety, not dust. G6-E-4:ash is volcanic ash; G6-E-5:before is volcano alerts. TL pilikmata / BIS pilok OK. Potential new body-protection/senses facet.

Vision contributing to postural balance (harder to stand still with eyes closed) is sound, but G10-L-1:balance is homeostasis (body-system balance: temperature/glucose/BP), a homonym trap. G7-F-2:rest is balanced forces (man standing still), not visual proprioception; G3-E-9 is Sun-light eye protection. TL/BIS balanse/piyong OK. Potential new G6 senses/nervous-system facet.

Water boils at 212°F is correct, but G7-M-5:heating is particle-arrangement/energy change of state, not a Fahrenheit boiling-point fact. G5-M-8 units are milligrams/grams/kilograms/degrees centigrade, not Fahrenheit. Water hits are basic-needs/habitat traps. TL/BIS keep Fahrenheit. Potential G7-M-5 after boiling-point/particle wording, or G5-M-8 after Celsius (not °F) unit-use.

Moon craters from ancient impacts, lasting because there is no air to smooth the surface, is sound, but app vs merged copy differ ('Big space rocks crashed' vs 'Moon craters formed when big space rocks crashed'), an unresolved identity issue. G3-E-6:moon is guided sky observation; G5-E-11 objects is asteroid|comet (not admitted); G9-E-9 meteoroids/asteroids is not admitted. TL/BIS crater/buwan OK. Potential G5-E-11/G9-E-9 after impact-crater facet and identity repair.

Faraday is more often Father of electromagnetism/induction than 'Father of Electricity' (card hedges with 'often called' and 'discoveries', not an invention). G4-M-1 is not admitted (needs invent|develop|creat) and requires identifying a scientist AND their invention/s. G9-M-11 electrical is substance conductivity; G8-F-10 generation is hydropower. TL Ama ng Kuryente / BIS Amahan sa Koryente OK. Potential G4-M-1 after scientist-discovery (electromagnetic induction) wording.

Faster spin as more full turns in the same time is a sound angular-speed idea, but G4-F-4 is construct/label speed graphs (activity, not credited). G8-F-1/G8-F-7 rate are acceleration and power as rate of work, not rotational speed; G4-F-3 needs distance.*time; G6-F-1 wheel is simple machines. TL pag-ikot / BIS pagtuyok OK. Potential G4-F-3 or G8-F-1 after rotational-speed facet.

A drill bit spinning faster to cut holes is a tool-use description, not G6-F-1 simple machines (not admitted) and not G4-M-2 identifying a science invention and its everyday impact (make is a keyword). G4-F-4/F-5 are speed graphs and push-pull guided activities (not credited); G3-E-2 does not say what natural materials make a drill. TL/BIS keep drill. Potential G6-F-1 after screw/wedge/compound-machine, or G4-M-2 after invention-impact wording.

SR-71 Blackbird ~3,500 km/h / Mach 3 is in the published record range, but it is speed trivia, not G4-F-4 constructing speed graphs (activity, not credited) or G4-F-3 distance-time. Guided-investigation hits are filters. TL/BIS keep SR-71 Blackbird/Mach. Potential G4-F-3 after a speed-example facet.

Usain Bolt as the fastest recorded human is correct trivia, but G4-F-4 is speed graphs (not credited) and G4-F-3 distance-time is not admitted. G4-L-5:human is life-cycle stages; record hits are weather/sky recording. TL/BIS keep Usain Bolt. Potential G4-F-3 after a human-speed example facet.

Cheetah sprint ~100–120 km/h is within commonly published range, but G4-F-3 needs distance.*time (not admitted; same miss as prior cheetah hold) and G4-F-4 is speed graphs (not credited). G4-L-3:land is a drawing/diagram habitat classification (not credited; cheetah is not a Philippine example). TL/BIS keep cheetah. Potential G4-F-3 after speed-example facet.

Nothing travels faster than light (vacuum cosmic speed limit) is sound, but G4-F-9/G4-F-10 are energy forms/uses of light, not speed; G4-F-8 is light affecting at a distance; G3-F-6 is guided light activities (not credited); G6-F-9 transverse waves and G9-F-10 EMR-through-space are not taught. TL liwanag / BIS kahayag OK. Potential G6-F-4 or G9-F-10 after speed-of-light/EMR facet.

Leeuwenhoek as first to see microbes (popular Father of Microbiology) is standard, but G4-M-1 scientist+invention is not admitted (needs invent|develop|creat; microscope not named as invention). G5-L-4 microorganism table is not admitted; G7-L-1 microscope parts/handling is not admitted; G10-L-6 microb is biotechnology. TL Mikrobyolohiya / BIS Microbiology OK. Potential G4-M-1 after scientist+microscope-invention wording, or G7-L-1 after first-microscopy facet.

Fe del Mundo as National Scientist for children's health is correct, but G4-M-1 requires identifying a scientist AND their invention/s and is not admitted (needs invent|develop|creat). The card does not name the bamboo incubator or any invention. G4-M-2:uses is invention impact, not a title. Philippine hits are volcano/typhoon/food-chain traps. TL/BIS keep National Scientist. Potential G4-M-1 after Filipino-scientist+invention (incubator) wording.
